name: Greater Sanguine Sorcery (Heritage)
body:
You have honed the magic of your heritage to its peak.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Sanguine Sorcery, 13th level or higher.

Benefit(s): Choose confusion, dimension door, or shadow conjuration. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 15th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.
